reviewer: fnn-initialize (io.lisp:2389-2392) loads the existing config when the link returns :existing, and does not compare it with the requested profile frame. The groups are skipped whenever config history exists (io.lisp:2393). fnn-command-init (io.lisp:3968-3977) then prints "initialized" and exits 0. It is reachable through `store ROOT init` (fnn-dispatch io.lisp:8243 to fnn-command-developer-init io.lisp:4041). The init is resumable on purpose, but a mismatched profile goes unreported. The operator path, fnn-command-init-published (io.lisp:4001), refuses an existing path, so only the developer/store verb is affected.
scenario: An operator runs `store ROOT init --profile production` (through fn-nop-developer-init) on a root that was initialized earlier with :development, or with different groups. config.json's link returns EEXIST and the old profile is loaded silently. The command exits 0 with "initialized ROOT", and the store keeps running under the development profile's bounds and durability policy. Nothing compares the requested frame with the existing one.
title: `init` over an existing store ignores the requested profile and groups and still prints "initialized"
